description: This source file defines the ValueLinkServices class, which provides a suite of static methods for integrating with the ValueLink Gift Card system within an OFBiz-based project. It includes functionalities for key management, gift card activation, redemption, balance inquiry, transaction history, reloading, and various administrative actions like linking physical cards, disabling PINs, and handling refunds. It also contains higher-level services for processing gift card purchases, reloads, and fulfillment processes, interacting with other OFBiz services and entities, sending emails, and managing fulfillment records.

classes.name: ValueLinkServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for integration with the ValueLink gift card system, including key management, card operations, and fulfillment handling.

methods.name: createKeys
methods.description: Generates and displays new public/private key pairs for ValueLink system.

methods.name: testKekEncryption
methods.description: Tests the KEK (Key Encryption Key) encryption and decryption process with ValueLink.

methods.name: assignWorkingKey
methods.description: Changes or updates the working key (MWK) for ValueLink, encrypts it, and updates the database accordingly.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a gift card with specified details, such as promo codes and amount, via ValueLink API.

methods.name: linkPhysicalCard
methods.description: Links a physical gift card with a virtual one in the ValueLink system.

methods.name: disablePin
methods.description: Disables the PIN of a gift card through ValueLink.

methods.name: redeem
methods.description: Redeems a gift card for a specified amount via ValueLink.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads value onto a gift card.

methods.name: balanceInquire
methods.description: Inquires the current balance of a gift card.

methods.name: transactionHistory
methods.description: Fetches the transaction history of a gift card.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Issues a refund on a gift card.

methods.name: voidRedeem
methods.description: Voids a redemption transaction.

methods.name: voidRefund
methods.description: Voids a refund transaction.

methods.name: voidReload
methods.description: Voids a reload transaction.

methods.name: voidActivate
methods.description: Voids an activation of a gift card.

methods.name: timeOutReversal
methods.description: Handles timeout reversal for various gift card operations.

methods.name: giftCardProcessor
methods.description: Wrapper for processing gift card transactions such as redeeming, releasing, and refunds, with interactions to other OFBiz services.

methods.name: giftCardRelease
methods.description: Releases (reverses) a gift card purchase.

methods.name: giftCardRefund
methods.description: Processes a gift card refund.

methods.name: giftCardPurchase
methods.description: Initiates a gift card purchase and creates related fulfillment records, sends confirmation emails.

methods.name: giftCardReload
methods.description: Performs reload of a gift card including survey handling and fulfillment.
